audit.why: The mirror set lucian__sylas to HARD, i.e. Lucian finds this matchup hard. My side reading TRICKY 7/10 is the exact inverse-contradiction mirror-fix.js exists to catch — both pages cannot describe the same lane as difficult for their own champion.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet's defect line is right: the full layer names only Relentless Pursuit, and never with a number, so 'commit on its cooldown' has no window. It also omits that Lightslinger refunds that cooldown — which is what makes counting his autos, not seconds, the correct read.
audit.why: Kit: Relentless Pursuit is 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s and its text states Lightslinger attacks reduce its cooldown; Piercing Light is 9/8/7/6/5s at 500 range; The Culling is 110/100/90s.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns and report[5] now carry the 16s and the Lightslinger refund; phases[3].why keys the punish to the spent dash.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer never mentions the double-shot, so nothing warns the reader that each of his casts loads extra damage into the following auto.
The _missing file lists needs-antiheal on Lightslinger, implying Grievous Wounds should be bought.
audit.why: Riot's own passive text says Lucian gains bonus magic damage 'when Lucian is healed or shielded by an ally' — that is an incoming buff, not Lucian healing himself. The heal flag is a tooltip-parsing misfire and the description overrides it.
audit.corrected: No anti-heal added — it would be a fabricated purchase.
